paragraphs: A curated collection of 490+ AI-powered development tools and agent-orchestration resources to supercharge your coding workflow 🔥

This comprehensive list showcases the latest and greatest AI-powered development tools that are revolutionizing software development. These tools leverage artificial intelligence to make developers more productive, efficient, and creative.

requirements.text: Atomic Agent - A local-first CLI and TUI coding agent that runs open-weight models on your machine via llama.cpp, with no account or API key required, built-in tools, MCP support, and local memory.
Atomic Agent - A local-first CLI and TUI coding agent that runs open-weight models on your machine via llama.cpp, with no account or API key required, built-in tools, MCP support, and local memory.
Bolt.diy - An open-source, self-hosted version of Bolt.new with support for multiple LLM providers (Groq, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.) for building full-stack applications.

Sillage - Self-hosted, mobile-first web UI for driving the native Claude Code and Codex CLIs on your own machine, with persistent sessions, conversation search, an IDE panel, and an MCP-backed task board.
